ruleDefinitions.name: Renamed AutoHotkey.EXE Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of a renamed autohotkey.exe binary based on PE metadata fields

sequences.query: (process_product = RGX(".*AutoHotkey.*") OR process_description = RGX(".*AutoHotkey.*") OR (process_original_file_name = "AutoHotkey\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "AutoHotkey\.rc")) AND  NOT (((process_path = RGX("\\\\AutoHotkey\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\AutoHotkey32\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\AutoHotkey32\\_UIA\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\AutoHotkey64\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\AutoHotkey64\\_UIA\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\AutoHotkeyA32\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\AutoHotkeyA32\\_UIA\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\AutoHotkeyU32\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\AutoHotkeyU32\\_UIA\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\AutoHotkeyU64\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\AutoHotkeyU64\\_UIA\\\.exe$")) OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\AutoHotkey.*")))
